divergences.upstreamResult: React uses scalar refs and a forwarding wrapper.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane accepts recursive refs as ordinary component props.
divergences.rationale: The binding implements the upstream public behavior with Octane framework primitives.
divergences.consumerImpact: Consumers can compose native ref arrays and callback cleanups.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use Octane refs with the binding; React forwarding wrappers are unnecessary.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when the corresponding Octane framework contract changes.
